milestones.title: Repository and operating contract
Provider audio and security feasibility
Domain contracts and initial schema
Continuous integration and staging infrastructure
Guest identity accounts and role boundaries
milestones.implementationNotes: Guest web/native identities, revocable recovery keys and origin-scoped native Keychain credentials are implemented. PR25's genuine Simulator-to-API-to-stage interaction passed. Multi-artist provisioning, staff roles, display pairing and stronger artist authentication remain open.

milestones.title: Artist album and event preparation
milestones.implementationNotes: Revision-fenced settings and private unplayed-track edits include merged real MP3/WAV ingestion, validated duration, private content-addressed storage and stable authenticated delivery. A 192 kbps MP3 derivative is retained, not the original master. PR25's empty-start local upload/playback/persistence browser acceptance passed; real Neon delivery and owner-file/hardware acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Durable media ingest and local album cache
milestones.implementationNotes: IndexedDB album backup with SHA-256 verification and local continuation is implemented. PR25's separate persistent loopback database/audio runtime passed real browser acceptance. PR28 adds automatic deadline/controller reconciliation and graceful stream shutdown; its final native gate is pending. Hosted offline reload, physical routing and venue acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Playback leader queue and round lifecycle
Atomic five-point voting
Wave moderation and duplicate handling
Durable realtime subscriptions and recovery
milestones.implementationNotes: Event-log streaming and snapshot fallback reject older responses and pause stale/offline voting. Per-process snapshot bounds, identity isolation, shared-network budgets and slow-socket disconnection exist. PR28 tests stream shutdown without aborting ordinary requests. Multi-instance fanout and deployed venue/load evidence remain open.

milestones.title: Audience web app and stable voting controls
Production screen and baseline 3D waves
milestones.implementationNotes: The actual screen renderer displayed a native Simulator submission with its stored vote count in PR25. PR29's merged monitor launcher and exact native connection fields passed desktop/mobile browser checks. Physical display visibility, QR distance and venue acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Generation adapter durable jobs and cost reservation
milestones.implementationNotes: Frozen per-round selection dispatches Stable Audio 2.5 or Mureka instrumental text generation with no cross-provider fallback. Mureka task IDs persist before polling, and $0 blocks before attempts/cost/calls. Real provider billing, entitlement, quality and latency evidence remain unavailable under the current zero-spend allowance.

milestones.title: Prompt compiler and boundary dispatch
milestones.implementationNotes: Immutable private core prompts and selected Sound Waves form closed-round snapshots. Mureka's 1,024-character limit blocks without silent truncation; output length is provider-variable. Unknown tasks are not blindly resubmitted. Operator reconciliation UI and live-provider acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Validated synchronized releases and downloads
milestones.implementationNotes: Boundary/immediate/review policies, private preview, publication holds and never-dispatched cancellation preserve ownership, moderation and budget semantics. Both adapters validate decoded audio. Real provider/storage delivery, exports and production rollout remain open.

milestones.title: Listener player and trustworthy play metrics
Reactions comments and listening prompts
Release email push and preferences
milestones.implementationNotes: Verified opt-in email, encrypted contacts, bounded durable outbox, unsubscribe, signed suppression and foreground release notices are implemented behind disabled delivery. Real sender delivery, native/web push, crowd throughput and production migration remain open.

milestones.title: Performer feedback dashboard and Play next
milestones.implementationNotes: One-click queue reordering preserves current playback and rejects stale commands. A simple Mureka/Stable Audio selector and honest generation-failure activity panel are merged. Private-cue hardware rehearsal remains open.

milestones.title: Private headphone cue and audio diagnostics
milestones.implementationNotes: Capability-detected outputs, distinct-output test tones/confirmation, selected-sink playback and output-loss recovery are implemented. Separate headphone-device fallback remains. Physical isolation, recording exclusion and native output acceptance are open.

milestones.title: Recoverable recording and hardware tier support
milestones.implementationNotes: Checksummed local recording selects exact browser inputs and handles disconnection. Synthetic browser coverage does not verify physical Rave/USB routing, long sessions or multitrack capture.

milestones.title: Profiles avatars and core leaderboards
Artist pages event archives and album commerce
milestones.implementationNotes: Public profiles, archives and liked tracks include remote voting policy, listener access, room-code admission and bounded contributor capacity. SwiftUI admission is implemented; core open-room native participation passed. Restricted-room native UI, Expo parity, physical devices and venue-load acceptance remain open.

milestones.title: Security privacy and content release review
Load monitoring recovery and full show rehearsal
milestones.implementationNotes: The owner confirmed Phillip's workspace and prior scoped migration approval. The free Render create was safety-blocked and not rerouted; no hosted deployment is claimed. The isolated Neon branch has a private media bucket and restricted runtime role. PR25's real local upload/participation/stage/$0/restart and native-to-stage tests passed; PR28 final lifecycle acceptance is pending. Live S3, cloud and physical venue evidence remain open.

milestones.title: First production event release gate
Cinematic wave rendering and visual identity
milestones.implementationNotes: Readable wave layout is separate from a lazy 3D renderer, with saved motion preferences, hidden/offscreen suspension and graphics-loss fallback. Physical frame/thermal, advanced packing and cinematic refinement remain open.

milestones.title: Dense crowds adaptive layout and discovery
Advanced recognition and leaderboard analytics
Fan collections following and return journeys
milestones.implementationNotes: Recoverable guest profiles, revocable keys, artist following and private public-release feeds are implemented on web/API. PR30 adds native recovery/follow controls and tests; compilation and core checks passed but actual native UI acceptance remains pending. Verified accounts and richer engagement remain open.

milestones.title: Native iOS and Android foundation
milestones.implementationNotes: PR25 delivered an actual SwiftUI Simulator app with verified Keychain/native contribution/vote/public-stage interaction. Both architectures compiled; iPhone SE iOS26.2 supplied interaction evidence. Expo draft11 and Android remain security-blocked/separate. Apple membership/signing, TestFlight, physical devices, full native parity and store acceptance remain open.
